svg.title: STM32MP1 heterogeneous-core ranging platform architecture
svg.desc: Top row: VL53L0X sensor, device-tree resource management, and Cortex-A7. Bottom row: Cortex-M4 and touchscreen. The sensor supplies measurements to M4 over I2C5; resource management reserves I2C5 and PA11/PA12. A7 sends START, STOP, and STATUS over RPMsg1; M4 returns distance, sequence, and timestamp over RPMsg0. A7 drives the display and receives touch input.
